hook_text: One orange can take you through the whole of Term 3, from the farm to the far side of the world.
clip_script: Limpopo, picking season. A worker on a ladder picks an orange by hand: commercial farming. It is washed and packed in a packhouse, then a truck carries it down the highway, the same road where ox-wagons once took weeks. At Durban harbour, a crane lifts its container onto a giant ship. Some oranges even fly in the belly of a jet. One orange, one journey: food, farming and transport through time.
visual_style: Whiteboard route map from a Limpopo orchard to a packhouse, a truck, a train, a harbour and a ship, with tiny drawings of an ox-wagon, a steam train and a balloon along the edge as reminders of the past.
mood: Lively and confident, like a journey you already know the way for.
pacing: One stop per beat, quick and clear, then the pocket summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace the journey of one food in your kitchen.
